  const imageUrl = config.assets?.imageUrl || '/prism-mock/home/nodes/floating-accent.png';
  const tex = ctx.textureLoader(imageUrl);
  
  // --- Atlas region ---
  const sourceRect = config.atlasRegion?.sourceRect || { x: 0, y: 0, w: 512, h: 320 };
  const regionW = sourceRect.w || 512;
  const regionH = sourceRect.h || 320;
  
  // Determine atlas dimensions
  const atlasW = tex.image?.width || tex.width || regionW;
  const atlasH = tex.image?.height || tex.height || regionH;
  
  // UV offset and repeat for atlas sampling
  const repeatX = regionW / atlasW;
  const repeatY = regionH / atlasH;
  const offsetX = sourceRect.x / atlasW;

  const offsetY = 1.0 - (sourceRect.y + regionH) / atlasH;

  material.colorNode = texColor.add(grain);

  // Position
  const pos = config.position || [0, -0.3, 0];
  mesh.position.set(pos[0], pos[1], pos[2]);
  
  // Rotation
  const rot = config.rotation || [0, 0, 0];
  mesh.rotation.set(rot[0], rot[1], rot[2]);
  
  // Scale
  const scale = config.scale || [1, 1, 1];
  mesh.scale.set(scale[0], scale[1], scale[2]);
  
  // --- Billboarding ---
  mesh.onBeforeRender = (renderer, scene, camera) => {
    mesh.quaternion.copy(camera.quaternion);
  };
  
  // --- UserData ---
  mesh.userData.handlers = {};
  
  mesh.userData.cleanup = () => {

    mesh.onBeforeRender = null;
